a novel 3D tubuliform nanofiber‐based drug delivery system for intracanal antimicrobial therapy.
a new cell‐friendly approach for the elimination of microbial flora, which is a key step for the success of regenerative endodontic therapy.

the development and evaluation of an innovative triple antibiotic–eluted 3‐dimensionally (3D) shaped nanofibrous polymer construct for the disinfection of infected root canals before regenerative endodontology.

the proposed 3D nanofibrous antibiotic construct is a cell‐friendly disinfecting strategy that may be used in conjunction with other cell‐friendly disinfections strategies to eliminate the microbial flora before regenerative endodontology.
